full_name: Eurostat GISCO Local Administrative Units (municipalities) with population

features.definition: Population of the LAU (municipality) as published by Eurostat GISCO with the LAU boundaries of that vintage (POP_<year>). Per country the loader takes the latest vintage in which the country reported population (LAU 2024 carries 0 for Spain and France, so they come from LAU 2023).
Area of the LAU in km2, computed from the GISCO boundary in ETRS89-LAEA (EPSG:3035). GISCO's own AREA_KM2 is not used: it is wrong in LAU 2023 for Spain (97 % of LAUs off by more than 10 %).
